questions.question: What does chapter 33 record?
options: The list of Israel's journey stages from Egypt
The record of a great battle in the desert
The numbering of the fighting men by tribe
The laws for keeping the yearly festivals
questions.answer: The list of Israel's journey stages from Egypt

questions.question: What did God command Israel to do to the inhabitants of Canaan and their idols?
options: Drive them out and destroy their idols
Make peace and live quietly alongside them
Tax them and spare their temples
Leave them alone and pass them by
questions.answer: Drive them out and destroy their idols

questions.question: Moses recorded the starting points of Israel's journeys at God's command.
